title: Snow and Santa Saturday, dinosaurs back in PV, Long Beach's free Veterans Day party
intro: Holiday season starts early this year. Saturday has real snow and Santa in Rancho Palos Verdes, life-size dinosaurs back at South Coast Botanic Garden, Long Beach's free Veterans Day festival, and Citadel's tree lighting with a snow show that night. Sunday is quieter, so we picked ocean science in San Pedro. Veterans Day is Wednesday and most schools are off, so we included a few easy outings for that too. We left parking, food, and prices blank unless an official page confirmed them.

picks.name: Snow Play and Santa Day
picks.when: Saturday, November 7, 11:00 a.m.–3:00 p.m. (Elsa and Anna 11:30 a.m.–12:30 p.m.)
picks.address: Christ Lutheran Church & School, 28850 S. Western Ave (check in at the side gate for wristbands)
picks.cost_math: Tickets are $30 per child (official Eventbrite page) → 2 kids = $60. No adult ticket price is listed. Parking is free (Eventbrite). Tickets are non-refundable.
picks.parking: Free parking (official Eventbrite listing). Lot at Christ Lutheran on Western Ave.
picks.food: Food on site (organizer listing); prices not listed. Local vendors and holiday shopping too.
picks.why: Real snow and a sledding ramp, Santa, Queen Elsa and Princess Anna, a bounce house, crafts, and face painting, 10 minutes from Torrance.

picks.price_text: Free with garden admission ($18 adult, $8 child 3–12)
picks.name: Dinosaurs Around the World (opening weekend)
picks.when: Opens Saturday, November 7; garden open daily 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. (last entry 4:30 p.m.). End date not listed.
picks.address: South Coast Botanic Garden, 26300 Crenshaw Blvd
picks.cost_math: The dinosaurs are free with garden admission (official): 2 adults × $18 + 2 kids (3–12) × $8 = $52. Toddlers 2 and under free. Optional add-ons: guided Walking with Giants tour $18 + admission per non-member; Pangea Express ride $23 + admission per non-member.
picks.food: Dottie's concession stand and a picnic area near the Living Wall (official).
picks.why: Ten life-size animatronic dinosaurs, including a T. rex, return across the garden's 87 acres. New this year: a climbable Parasaurolophus for photos.

picks.name: Long Beach Veterans Day Celebration
picks.cost_math: Free (City of Long Beach). Food trucks are pay-as-you-go; prices not listed. Parking not listed beyond ADA parking.
picks.parking: ADA parking and paratransit drop-off on Harding Street between Atlantic and Myrtle (city page). General parking is not listed; expect street parking.
picks.food: Food trucks and a beer garden for adults (city press release). Prices not listed.
picks.why: A free park festival with a kids' zone, a boot camp-style obstacle course, swing-era and '80s cover bands, and a veterans resource fair. Bring lawn chairs.

picks.name: STEAM Fest at the Aquarium of the Pacific
picks.address: Aquarium of the Pacific, 100 Aquarium Way
picks.cost_math: Included with general admission (official): 2 adults × $49.95 + 2 kids (3–11) × $34.95 = $169.80, plus $8 all-day parking with Aquarium validation → about $178. Under 3 and members free. Reservations required.
picks.parking: Aquarium Parking Structure on Shoreline Dr: $8 for the day with Aquarium validation (official parking page).
picks.food: Aquarium cafe, or The Pike and Shoreline Village next door. No event food listed.
picks.why: A morning of science and engineering booths from partner groups and a giant group coloring project, on top of the regular aquarium.

picks.name: Citadel Outlets Tree Lighting Concert
picks.when: Saturday, November 7, 5:00–7:15 p.m. (concert starts at 5:00 p.m.)
picks.cost_math: Free, open entry, no tickets required (official). Parking is not listed on the event page.
picks.parking: Citadel Outlets lots. The event page does not list parking details or fees.
picks.food: Outlet restaurants and food court. No event food listed.
picks.why: The first big tree lighting of the season: Santa lights a giant fresh-cut tree, then a snow show in center court. About 30 minutes from Torrance.

picks.name: Family Science Sunday at Marine Mammal Care Center
picks.when: Sunday, November 8, sessions at 11:00 a.m., 1:00, 2:00, and 3:00 p.m. (one hour each)
picks.address: Marine Mammal Care Center, 3601 S. Gaffey St #8 (turn up Barlow Saxton Rd at 32nd St)
picks.cost_math: $1 non-refundable booking fee per participant (official) → $4 for 4. You get a $1 gift-shop or donation coupon each when you show up. Code MMCARE waives the fee for hardship. Parking free.
picks.parking: Free parking in front of the hospital (official Visit page).
picks.food: No food on site listed. Downtown San Pedro is about 10 minutes away.
picks.why: A one-hour hands-on ocean science session, then watch the seals and sea lions being rehabbed. Best for ages 8 and up. The topic changes weekly.
picks.age_gate: Ages 8 and up; adults must accompany kids 13 and under

picks.name: Manhattan Beach Veterans Day Ceremony
picks.address: Veterans Parkway, Valley Drive and Ardmore Ave
picks.cost_math: Free (City of Manhattan Beach). Light refreshments and an ice cream truck (LA County Military and Veterans Affairs listing). Parking not listed.
picks.parking: Not listed. Street parking near Valley Dr and Ardmore Ave.
picks.food: Light refreshments and a sponsored ice cream truck (county listing).
picks.why: Most schools are off for Veterans Day. A short outdoor ceremony with a flyover by the South Bay Tiger Squadron, and ice cream after.

picks.name: Santa's Arrival at Del Amo Fashion Center
picks.address: Del Amo Fashion Center, 3525 W. Carson St (Santa Set, Main Level, in front of Macy's Women)
picks.cost_math: Free to watch, with samples and giveaways while supplies last. Santa photo packages are extra; prices not listed.
picks.parking: Del Amo lots. No fee listed.
picks.food: Mall restaurants. No event food listed.
picks.why: Santa officially arrives at the South Bay's biggest mall, and photos start the same day. Go at 9 to beat the line.

picks.name: Diwali: Lunada Bay's Festival of Lights
picks.address: Lunada Bay Park, 2201 Palos Verdes Dr W
picks.cost_math: Tickets must be bought online in advance. The organizer page doesn't list prices; a local guide (Palos Verdes Pulse) lists $40 ages 10+, $20 ages 5–9, under 5 free. If accurate, 2 adults + 2 kids ages 5–9 = $120. Confirm on the ticket page.
picks.parking: Street parking on Palos Verdes Dr West, Via Anacapa, or Yarmouth Rd (event listing).
picks.why: A sunset Diwali party on the bluff with Bollywood music, henna, games, a raffle, and catered Indian food.

picks.name: Manhattan Beach Pier Lighting & Holiday Open House
picks.when: Wednesday, November 18, 6:00–9:00 p.m. (pier lights at 7:00 p.m.)
picks.address: Downtown Manhattan Beach and the Manhattan Beach Pier
picks.cost_math: Free (City of Manhattan Beach). Shops and restaurants stay open late. Pier parking lots close that afternoon.
picks.parking: Lower pier lots close at 2 p.m. and upper pier lots at 3 p.m. (city closure notice). Park in the downtown structures or walk in.
picks.food: Downtown restaurants. Hot cocoa listed at Metlox Plaza and the Roundhouse Aquarium while supplies last.
picks.why: The South Bay's big holiday kickoff: school choirs, carolers, Santa at Metlox, and the whole pier lighting up at 7.

picks.name: Madrona Marsh Nature Walk
picks.address: Madrona Marsh Nature Center, 3201 Plaza del Amo
picks.cost_math: Free; no registration (Friends of Madrona Marsh).
picks.parking: Nature Center lot. No fee listed.
picks.why: A docent-led walk to spot the marsh's birds and plants. Walks can be canceled for weather, so call first.

picks.name: Cabrillo Tidepool Walk
picks.address: Cabrillo Marine Aquarium, 3720 Stephen M White Dr (walk goes to the Point Fermin tidepools)
picks.cost_math: Free and open to all ages (official). Cabrillo Beach parking is $3/hr with a $9 daily max → up to $9.
picks.why: Aquarium educators lead a short orientation, then a naturalist-led hike to the Point Fermin tidepools. Wear sneakers.

picks.name: Kids Club at South Bay Galleria
picks.address: South Bay Galleria, 1815 Hawthorne Blvd (Level 3 food court)
picks.cost_math: Free; RSVP requested (organizer page). Crafts and goodies while supplies last.
picks.why: An hour of crafts, a character dance party, and a meet-and-greet in the food court. Easy for little kids.

picks.name: Visit with a Veteran at the Torrance Historical Society
picks.address: Torrance Historical Society & Museum, 1345 Post Ave
picks.cost_math: No cost to attend (LA County Military and Veterans Affairs listing).
picks.parking: Not listed. Old Torrance street parking.
picks.why: Kids can sit down with veterans from WWII through Afghanistan and ask their own questions.

picks.name: American Legion Post 184 Veterans Day BBQ
picks.cost_math: Free and open to the public (official). Burgers, hot dogs, and hot links from the grill; potluck sides and desserts welcome. Donations to Joseph's Gift appreciated.
picks.parking: Post lot is handicapped-only. Park on Pearl St and walk down the drive; a golf cart shuttles guests (official).
picks.food: Grilled burgers, hot dogs, and hot links provided; bring a side or dessert if you can.
picks.why: A free cookout on Veterans Day with a Redondo High MCJROTC flag ceremony and live jazz.

picks.name: Hermosa for the Holidays
picks.when: Saturday–Sunday, November 21–22 (tree lighting with Santa's arrival Sunday 5:45–6:15 p.m.)
picks.cost_math: Free to attend. Ferris wheel is $9 per ticket, card only (official). Santa photos Sunday 10 a.m.–4 p.m.; price not listed.
picks.parking: Downtown Hermosa structures and meters; rates not listed on the event page.
picks.why: A Ferris wheel on Pier Plaza, letters to Santa, Rock for Tots, and Sunday's tree lighting.

picks.name: Autumn Festival at the Aquarium of the Pacific
picks.address: Aquarium of the Pacific, 100 Aquarium Way
picks.cost_math: Included with general admission (official): 2 × $49.95 + 2 × $34.95 = $169.80, plus $8 validated parking → about $178. Reservations required.
picks.parking: Aquarium Parking Structure: $8 for the day with validation (official).
picks.food: Aquarium cafe or nearby Shoreline Village.
picks.why: The 25th annual festival of Chinese, Japanese, Korean, and Filipino music, dance, crafts, and storytelling.
